Own papers (author Sztal-Mazer S, abstracts already read, cached): 42562434 menopause/osteoporosis management AJGP 2026; 41989128 TrAFFiC AFF Asian ethnicity cohort (166 AFF patients, Asian OR 2.10 earlier-onset AFF ≤5y anti-resorptive; SE Asian OR 3.25); 40608198 PA screening in hyperparathyroidism+HTN (275 pts, 15.6% had guideline indication, only 4/43 screened); 37264889 CGRP mAb bone turnover prospective cohort (45 pts, P1NP 44.5→51.5 µg/L p=0.004, CTX ns); 36880383 mixed insulin for prednisolone-induced hyperglycaemia (retrospective 53 inpatients, BGL morning 12.7→9.2 mmol/L p<0.001). Now reading authorship views for affiliationIndex values (Alfred affiliations noted earlier: 41989128 aff_4 'Department of Endocrinology and Diabetes, Alfred Health'; 37264889 aff_3 Alfred; 36880383 aff_1 Alfred; 40608198 Alfred per notes).

Field papers (GDM/pregnancy endocrine scope, abstracts read or being re-read now for citations): 42717332 GLP-1 RA/SGLT2 post-GDM; 42712092 late-onset GDM review; 42711707 CGM in GDM; 42706499 IMH maternal/infant outcomes meta; 42703955 remnant cholesterol GDM systematic review; 42693441 menstrual cycle length GDM/FET (aOR 1.54 ≥36d; short cycles aOR 0.48); 42684490 maternal DM–MS offspring meta (common-effect RR 1.42, random-effects ns, I²=95.2%); 42684327 GooD4Mum QIC protocol (non-randomized practice-level trial, 9 practices).

Plan: after these reads, submit evidence object (zh-CN): facts = position (endocrinologist Alfred clinics), expertise (gestational diabetes/endocrine disease in pregnancy, osteoporosis/metabolic bone, women's endocrinology, diabetes clinic per directory), research_direction + representative_output from 5 own papers; topics anchored by directory page + own papers; coreEvidence 5-6 rows from field papers; limitations: Monash profile 403; no admin title verified; abstract-only access.
